title: Zesty Kenyan Nectarine Skewers
description: A romantic Kenyan dish featuring nectarines, this recipe is a nutty and light delight, perfect for a special occasion, and is low-glycemic-friendly to suit various dietary needs.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel and chop the nectarines into 1-inch pieces.
Using a mortar and pestle, pound the sliced almonds into a coarse crumb.
Add the ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, and a pinch of salt to the mortar and pestle, and mix until well combined.
Thread the nectarine pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the melted coconut oil onto the nectarine pieces.
Sprinkle the almond mixture evenly over the nectarine pieces.
Drizzle the honey and lemon juice over the skewers.
Place the skewers into the preheated fondue pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until the nectarines are tender.
Serve the Zesty Kenyan Nectarine Skewers warm, garnished with fresh ginger slices.
